status: TESLA SOP9 SOURCE FUNCTIONS VERIFIED; M141318 HARNESS ROUTING MUST BE REWORKED/CONFIRMED AGAINST SOP9
evidence: Tesla SOP9 connector metadata in this repository defines the standard-audio MCU source channels and exact source cavities on X171 and X175.
Car-Hifi Store Bunde confirmed that Front Left, Center and Front Right are the three instrument-panel speakers behind the windshield.
Owner-supplied photos show labelled IN +/-, OUT +/- conductors for Front Low Left, Front Low Right, Front Left, Center, Front Right, Rear Left and Rear Right.
Owner-supplied photos also show Optional Woofer 1/2 +/- leads.
Observed wire-family colors are photographic observations only; the Tesla SOP9 connector/cavity/net assignments below come from the repository electrical reference.

directionSemantics.IN: Tesla OEM speaker-level source -> HELIX V TWELVE DSP MK2 high-level input
directionSemantics.OUT: HELIX V TWELVE DSP MK2 amplified speaker output -> vehicle-side speaker return

rules: Tesla SOP9 source-channel functions and MCU connector cavities are authoritative from the repository electrical reference and are VERIFIED below.

Do not treat PP-TES 1.7B Ryzen M141318 as plug-and-play Highland hardware: its original internal pin-to-sleeve routing was designed for the earlier Ryzen vehicle generation and must be compared/reworked so each labelled conductor follows the verified SOP9 function map.
A continuity test of the modified M141318 is final harness QC, not a prerequisite for knowing what the SOP9 Tesla cavities mean.
Front tweeters are planned as DSP-derived outputs from the corresponding Front Left / Front Right dash source channels; they are not separate labelled PP-TES source channels.
Optional Woofer 1/2 leads are not Tesla parcel-shelf channels and remain separate from X588/X593.
